item.title: Iran proposes a 7-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's president says Tehran wants a deal with the U.S. before November's midterm elections, as the regime puts an offer on the table.

item.title: Hurricane Nolo could cause "catastrophic" flooding in Hawaii, forecasters warn
item.description: A hurricane watch is in effect for Hawaii County due to the storm, which could dump up to 3 feet of rain on Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: TikTok settles lawsuit over youth safety concerns for at least $100 million
item.description: Alabama sued the social media company in 2025, claiming the platform had negative effects on the mental well-being of youths.

item.title: What to watch for at this weekend's MTV Video Music Awards
item.description: The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards will be held this weekend with Snoop Dogg carrying out hosting duties. "Entertainment Tonight" correspondent Denny Directo joins CBS News for a preview.

item.title: Trump cancels nearly $1 billion in spending, a move some lawmakers called illegal
item.description: President Trump moved to cancel almost $1 billion in spending that was approved by Congress, marking the second time his administration has employed a rarely used tactic that some lawmakers in both parties have called illegal.

item.title: How El Niño is supercharging Pacific storms
item.description: While El Niño is a natural shift in the climate system, scientists say the weather pattern developing in the Pacific Ocean could be one of the strongest on record. And human-caused climate change is super-charging its strength, making weather extremes worse. Tracy Wholf, founder of WereWHOLF Media, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Supreme Court again blocks Missouri's new House map that favored GOP
item.description: The Supreme Court said in an unsigned decision that ordering Missouri to restore its 2025 map "would usher in electoral chaos."

item.title: Transcript: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan"
item.description: The following is the transcript of the interview with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian airing on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" on Sept. 27, 2026.

item.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian talks about proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's Masoud Pezeshkian, who is also a physician, says he has visited Iran's supreme leader twice and talked with CBS News' Margaret Brennan about Mojtaba Khamenei's health.

item.title: Extended interview: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on the U.S.-Iran war
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian speaks with Face the Nation's Margaret Brennan about the war with the U.S., his country's latest offer to open the Strait of Hormuz, the supreme leader's condition and more.

item.title: Twin doctors who grew up in poverty returned to their hometown to co-run an ER
item.description: Drs. Travan and Travis Jasper, identical twins, are co-directors of the emergency department at Chippenham Hospital in Richmond, Virginia, the city where they grew up in poverty.

item.title: Nor'easter barrels down on East Coast, threatens millions with flooding, winds
item.description: Tens of millions of people are in the path of the storm, which has already canceled concerts and prompted people on islands near Cape Cod, Massachusetts, to head to the mainland in the days ahead of the nor'easter's arrival.

item.title: Supreme Court allows use of database to review voter rolls
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday sided with the Trump administration in its push to use a controversial database to review state voter rolls. David Becker, executive director at the Center for Election Innovation and Research, joins CBS News to discuss what this means for voters.

item.title: Federal court says U.S. government can label Anthropic a supply chain risk
item.description: The growing concerns over the safety of artificial intelligence and the speed of its development have many calling for government regulation. Recently, President Trump said he plans to appoint an adviser and create an AI force. J.B. Branch, director of federal AI governance and technology policy at Public Citizen, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Iranian president pushes for new deal with U.S. in CBS News interview
item.description: CBS News chief foreign affairs correspondent and "Face the Nation" moderator Margaret Brennan spoke with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian about efforts to continue diplomacy with the U.S. Middle East contributor Courtney Kealy joins to unpack the leader's remarks.

item.title: Supreme Court again blocks Missouri map favoring Republicans after paving way for voter database
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday again blocked a Missouri congressional map that could have given Republicans an edge in the midterms. Earlier, the high court also allowed the Trump administration to use an expanded database to check voter citizenship. CBS News legal reporter Katrina Kaufman has more.

item.title: What to know about "panda diplomacy" as China sends 2 more furry friends to U.S.
item.description: China says it's sending two pandas to Zoo Atlanta, bringing the total number of Chinese pandas in the U.S. to six. Neil Thomas, senior fellow at the Asia Society's Center for China Analysis, joins CBS News to discuss the ins and outs of panda diplomacy.

item.title: Nation celebrates first "Dolly Parton Day" following country singer's death
item.description: On Sept. 25, fans of the late Dolly Parton celebrated the first "9-2-5" day in her honor, a reference to her hit country single "9 to 5," which was written for the hit movie of the same name. Mark Strassman reports from a children's hospital in Knoxville bearing her name.

item.title: Trump-Xi visit wraps up with few achievements announced
item.description: President Trump described Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit this week as "very productive," though the White House has said little about what was achieved during the summit.

item.title: U.S. military lays groundwork for potential action around Cuba
item.description: Some units would "possibly [be] needed in 90-120 days," according to an internal Army message reviewed by CBS News.

item.title: Scant details so far on what came from Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping wrapped their meeting Friday. CBS News' Natalie Brand has more.

item.title: ICE wasted millions in rapid push to expand detention capacity, watchdog finds
item.description: With an unprecedented budget, ICE spent billions in a rush to expand its detention network, wasting millions in the process, the Government Accountability Office found.

item.title: CEO of company behind FAA's new AI tool explains how the technology works
item.description: Washington, D.C., airports are debuting a new artificial intelligence tool designed to help air traffic controllers and airlines with future scheduling and weather issues. Air Space Intelligence CEO Phillip Buckendorf, whose company developed the system, joins "The Takeout" to explain how it works.

item.title: 9/25: CBS Evening News
item.description: Over 60 million in danger from Nor'easter; Hawaiians shelter ahead of Hurricane Nolo.

item.title: Soaring U.S. diesel prices slam local communities as fuel costs surge
item.description: The surge in diesel prices this year is putting a financial squeeze on schools, farms and small businesses around the U.S.

item.title: How GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are changing fast-food menus
item.description: Chipotle, McDonald's and Shake Shack are among the restaurant chains revamping their menus as more consumers go on weight-loss drugs.

item.title: Minnesota sailor returns from USS Lincoln duty to find apartment ransacked
item.description: A Minnesota native who had been serving aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln for nearly 10 months came home to an upsetting surprise.

item.title: Commander rejected plans to rebase before deadly drone strike, sources say
item.description: Sources tell CBS News that despite warnings about the vulnerability of the outpost in Kuwait, a commander opted not to rebase farther from Iran.

item.title: 9/24: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump hosts Xi Jinping at White House; Sen. Thom Tillis on elaborate Trump-Xi visit.

item.title: The Uplift: John Legend
item.description: We hear from John Legend about his newest project – and the legendary place he recorded it. Plus, two inspiring stories from David Begnaud.
